abstract: The advances in the therapy of high-volume stage II and stage III testicular cancer have been largely due to the development and success of cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Though patients with low- to moderate-volume stage II disease historically were curable with radical retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, patients with higher volumes of metastatic disease were not curable with surgery alone. The advent of cisplatin-based chemotherapy in the 1970s has allowed many of these patients with higher-volume metastatic disease to be cured. Though chemotherapy clearly plays the major role in the therapy of these patients, surgery after chemotherapy has been complimentary in the overall chance for cure of these patients.
abstract_ja: 大容量の病期II・III精巣がんの治療の進歩は、主にシスプラチン併用化学療法の開発と成功によるものです。低〜中等量の病期II病変は、歴史的に根治的後腹膜リンパ節郭清で治癒可能でしたが、より大容量の転移性疾患は手術単独では治癒できませんでした。1970年代のシスプラチン併用化学療法の登場により、より大容量の転移性疾患を持つ多くの患者が治癒可能となりました。化学療法がこれらの患者の治療で主要な役割を果たす一方、化学療法後の手術は、これらの患者の治癒の可能性を全体として高めるうえで補完的な役割を果たしてきました。
